body.name: Common-pair endpoint functionals
body.construction: Define \(q^-_{a,x}(w_0,w_1)=\min_{\theta\in\{\Gamma_a^{-1},\Gamma_a\}}q_{a,x}(w_0,w_1;\theta)\) and \(q^+_{a,x}(w_0,w_1)=\max_{\theta\in\{\Gamma_a^{-1},\Gamma_a\}}q_{a,x}(w_0,w_1;\theta)\).  Set \(H^-_x=q^-_{1,x}-q^+_{0,x}\), \(H^+_x=q^+_{1,x}-q^-_{0,x}\), \(\ell_x=\min_{D_{A,x}}H^-_x\), \(\upsilon_x=\max_{D_{A,x}}H^+_x\), \(L=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}\lambda_x\ell_x\), and \(R=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}\lambda_x\upsilon_x\).
